text_blocks.snippet: In the context of asthma, vital signs like respiratory rate, heart rate, and oxygen saturation are crucial indicators of severity, particularly during an exacerbation. Respiratory rate above 30 breaths per minute and heart rate above 120 beats per minute suggest severe asthma. Oxygen saturation below 90% also indicates a severe exacerbation. Other important signs include the use of accessory muscles for breathing, retractions (indrawing of the chest wall), and wheezing.
